reviews.text: Very unhappy with the service here, first of all found the groomer to be rude, unclear communication and felt as though excuses were being made for how I wanted my Pom to be groomed. When returning to pick her up the cut was choppy and uneven, and we were told she was found to have fleas on her, something that I can only say she could not possibly have had before arriving there as she is thoroughly groomed daily, and washed frequently due to “accidents”, as well as this she does not play with other dogs outside due to nerves, nor does she go into grass or anywhere she could have contracted fleas. So as far as we were concerned, she contracted the fleas while she was there, considering there were very few found on her, and we then only began to notice one or two more after leaving, something we would have absolutely been aware of if she had them before going for her groom. As well as this, our other dog at home who she interacts with 24/7, has no fleas whatsoever, which would be impossible if she’d had them before. Will not be going here again, would put zero stars if I could.
Very positive experience! Team member at the front desk was so friendly and efficient. Loved how they treated my dog!
Fantastic professional staff - my cat Timmy was heavily matted but the staff did an amazing job and he now looks like a handsome prince - an awesome service and great value
Great cuts - great customer service - great communication
The receptionist Anna was lovely. They groomed my cat to perfection, she has a shiny new coat. April did an excellent job.

Absolutely this place. Used this place for over 13 years now with my dog Luka and i have never had any complaints or issues. The prices are reasonable considering my dog is a big Yorkshire Terrier. The owner and her staff are amazing with Luka and they take such care with him. Over the years, they have taken their time with Luka and gotten to know what he likes and dislikes for example, he hates being dried with the hairdryer. He comes out always so fresh and the products they use have never caused Luka any issues with his skin etc. I will continue to use this place and i feel so lucky to have this groomers so locally to me
Great groomers. Been going there for years!

Highly Recommend
I Brought My Daughters Cat Minnie In To Be Groomed As She Was Severely Matted, April Managed To Achieve This For Us Even Though Minnie Is Aggressive
I Would Highly Recommend This Groomers and Thank You Once Again
Rachelle
Such nice and friendly staff. The haircuts they provided to my cats were excellent and I would go to them again.

Absolutely terrible experience, I'd strongly suggest taking your business elsewhere. Rude customer service and unclear communication, I appreciate that not all staff members who work here should be tarnished with the same brush, but unfortunately on this occasion we were left feeling very disappointed with how we'd been treated.
I take my cat here every few months for a full groom (he’s a ragdoll with very long hair) and they are so good with him even though he can be feisty!
We’ve been coming here with our 3 year old dog since his first groom and it’s always been a good experience.
Took my French bulldog there and I have no complaints, friendly staff and good service for a very good price. And they even managed to fit me in on short notice. Will definitely be coming back.
Fantastic groomers. Lovely and friendly service. My dog is always happy when she leaves ❤️
These guys are great! Always a lovely haircut for my cocker spaniel. Friendly service and completely priced.
Best grooming place in Islington, very thorough and very reasonably priced. My dog always comes out looking superb.
